[P3] Reconsider the unreachable output-status branch

The only caller reaches this helper after `invoke_handler()` constructs SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or PENDING. RETRY is constructed separately for plugin notification when an exception escapes; it never reaches this helper. Consequently, this early-return branch has no reachable production case and no test that requires it. CONTRIBUTING rule 4.4 explicitly prohibits defensive branches for impossible cases. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and simplify finalization around its actual reachable states.
